translations.web: They brought near the male goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly; and they laid their hands on them.
translations.bsb: Then they brought the goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly, who laid their hands on them.
translations.kjv: And they brought forth the he goats for the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:
translations.asv: And they brought near the he-goats for the sin-offering before the king and the assembly; and they laid their hands upon them:
